name: reader_with_details
title: P14 · a broker's listings, each with its own page read, every value with its page, the site's robots and terms kept

steps.say: Keep track of POE Advisors' US CPA firms for sale in a table: https://poegroupadvisors.com/buying/usa-cpa-firms-for-sale/?sort_by=listing_id&sort_order=ASC. Give each listing its own ID from the site, and read each listing's own page for its details. Check every day.
steps.reply:
The table **POE US CPA Firms for Sale** is set up, filled, and will be checked every day.

**What's in it now:** 47 listings from all 4 pages of Poe Group Advisors' US list:
- 38 for sale
- 8 with an acquisition pending
- 1 on hold

Each row is matched on the site's own listing ID (AL2001, CP2044 and so on). Each row has the title, status, location, asking price, annual gross and the feature tags from the list.
